datasets.name: National Health Mission HMIS - District Monthly Inpatient & Surveillance Indicators
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Government of India
datasets.coverage: Key Indian Health Surveillance Districts (Rajasthan State Focus: Jaipur, Jodhpur, Ajmer, Kota, Udaipur, Bikaner, etc.)
datasets.description: Aggregated monthly inpatient admissions, emergency footfalls, seasonal acute fever / respiratory disease trends, and hospital bed occupancy rates derived from public MoHFW HMIS portal releases.

datasets.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) - Health Facility Registry (HFR) Directory
datasets.source_organization: National Health Authority (NHA), Government of India
datasets.coverage: District Hospitals, Sub-Divisional Hospitals, and Community Health Centres (CHCs)
datasets.description: Functional health facility infrastructure registry detailing sanctioned and operational general beds, oxygen-supported beds, ICU/HDU capacity, and blood storage units per district.

datasets.name: Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP / IHIP) Public Outbreak Reports
datasets.source_organization: National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Directorate General of Health Services
datasets.coverage: District-level Weekly & Monthly Acute Respiratory / Vector-Borne Surge Signals
datasets.description: Epidemiological surveillance signals tracking seasonal surges in acute viral respiratory infections, dengue, and malaria case clusters across surveillance sentinel hospitals.

datasets.name: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner - District Population Projections
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
datasets.coverage: Indian District Population, Urbanization %, and Vulnerability Density
datasets.description: Projected district population, population density per sq km, and elderly vulnerability ratios utilized to establish baseline healthcare demand denominators.

datasets.name: HC-05 Challenge Generative Environment & Ground Truth
datasets.description: Synthesized 12-district time-series environment generating baseline demand, seasonal harmonic curves, noise epsilon ~ N(0, 64), nominal capacity c(d) = round(0.90 * b_d), and development surges of +35 units in districts 2 and 9 during months 38, 39, 40.
